newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sime says yet to start bank stake talks.
newsitem.headline: Sime says yet to start bank stake talks.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate Sime Darby Bhd said on Monday it has not started negotiations to acquire a controlling stake in Oriental Bank Bhd.
Sime group chief executive Nik Mohamed Yaacob said Oriental's majority shareholder, Malaysian Industrial Development Finance Bhd (MIDF), has yet to get approval from the central bank to open talks.
"We hope to start negotiations soon," he told reporters after a joint venture signing.
Sime has said it plans to buy 51 percent stake or more in Oriental Bank, which is 78.4 percent owned by MIDF.
Sime received approval from the central bank last month to negotiate with shareholders of the medium-sized bank to acquire a majority equity interest.
Sime has said it also plans to merge Oriental Bank with its Sime Bank Bhd, which has just changed its name from United Malayan Banking Bhd.
